summary: FMC Corp closed its previously announced sale of 30,319,166 newly issued common shares to Tessenderlo Group NV at $13.30/share for $403,244,907.80, giving the Belgian investor roughly 20.0% of FMC's outstanding stock. Concurrently, the parties signed an Investor Agreement and Registration Rights Agreement granting Tessenderlo board representation: a board expansion and investor-nominated independent director at the next board meeting, ongoing nomination rights while it holds at least 10%, and a board observer. Lock-up and registration mechanics apply. Watch for governance influence, potential overhang from future resales, and whether the stake precedes a broader strategic move.
